name: CO2 shipping and terminals
principle: Liquefied CO2 is carried by ship to an onshore receiving terminal, then piped to an offshore injection well. At Northern Lights in Norway, CO2 from Heidelberg Materials' Brevik cement plant is shipped to a terminal at Øygarden and injected 2,600 m below the seabed in the Aurora reservoir; first injection was reported on 25 August 2025. IEA rates CO2 shipping at TRL 8.

costs.basis: Global CCS Institute 2025 brief: USD 9/t at 1 Mtpa over 600 km to USD 50/t at 5 Mtpa over 1,200 km; dollar year not stated; shipping dominated by opex unlike pipeline capex
